name: Inbar's Giant-Friend

automation.text: Your eyes flash with golden light. The Giant must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, its attitude toward you improves 1 step, such as from Hostile to Indifferent or Indifferent to Friendly. A creature's attitude is dynamic, so how you behave toward the giant from this point on can further affect its attitude. A Giant with Immunity to the Charmed condition has Immunity to this spell. Once you have cast this spell on any given Giant, you cannot cast it again on that Giant.

casttime: Reaction, which you take when a Giant sees you

components.material: a hair or nail clipping from a goblinoid
